# Evidence for the fourteen specified papers

The [V3 scope](../../LUU_NIEN_RESEARCH_V3_14_PAPERS_SPEC_20261115/00_START_HERE/README.md) expands ten legacy studies into fourteen candidate papers and explicitly includes ML/FL where the question warrants it. The [official crosswalk](../../LUU_NIEN_RESEARCH_V3_14_PAPERS_SPEC_20261115/01_AUDIT/LN_TO_P_MAPPING.md) identifies reused assets. The [fourteen V4.2 contracts](../../LUU_NIEN_RESEARCH_V4_2_NOVELTY_WIN_CONTRACT_20261116/03_PAPERS/) specify different primary endpoints. This table compares them with the current public-data studies. A replacement endpoint needs its own distinct research question, held-out comparison and manuscript before it can count. The [ten-method audit](TEN_METHODS.md) applies the revised portfolio criterion of at least three strong wins. Each study keeps its registered practical margin.

| ID | Specified contribution | What the available tests establish and what remains |
|---|---|---|
| P01 | Selective risk under course and term shift | [Matched-coverage predictions](coverage/manuscript.md) show that confidence selection alone explains the measured future-cohort improvement. A worst-course benefit under equal review capacity is open. |
| P02 | Exact constrained itinerary replanning | [Boston corridor study](replanning/corridor/README.md) checks exact arrivals under simulated cancellations. The matched solver was faster. Heritage evidence rights, accessibility and opening-window constraints also differ from transport routing. |
| P03 | Pedagogical scaffolding in generated responses | [MRBench](tutoring/manuscript.md) measures the released guidance label on selected responses. The training-selected fixed tutor beats the adaptive scorers. Generating better responses under a common backbone/token budget is a different endpoint. |
| P04 | Detect real curriculum shift and reproduce stratum rankings | [Cross-course prediction](dropout/manuscript.md) quantifies transfer and calibration failures. The [assessment-count screen](curriculum_shift/assessment/README.md) found two structural changes across 15 transitions. Its quiz detector lost to resource inventory. It still lacks labels for curriculum failure strata. |
| P05 | Forgetting-aware next-question prediction | [ASSIST2015](knowledge_tracing/manuscript.md) missed the practical loss margin. On [EdNet](knowledge_tracing/published_simplekt/README.md), the candidate beat upstream simpleKT but lost to the clock-aware control. A two-dataset all-control result remains open. The [Duolingo recall paper](recall/manuscript.md) uses a different prediction target. |
| P06 | Fair prioritization under binding review capacity | [FA*IR and quota comparisons](allocation/manuscript.md) measure which recorded dropout cases enter the review list. In the [course calibration study](allocation/transport/README.md), all three threshold variants selected the same 496 learners. The precision interval crossed the permitted one-point loss. |
| P07 | Select rights-eligible, relevant media under a resource budget | [Museum comparison](media_rights/manuscript.md) measures reliability of metadata proxies. The [file-level audit](media_rights/file_declarations/README.md) verified declarations on four development images. All four describe public-domain material. The comparison still needs open and restricted files with independent object labels and relevance judgments. |
| P08 | Reward-ledger safety and cost | [V3 evidence](../../research_artifacts_v3/runs/p08/evaluation_results.json) evaluates software fixtures. An equivalent comparison against the standard transactional ledger on the defined workload, with operating costs and stated guarantees, remains open. |
| P09 | Evidence-grounded answers about heritage | [SciFact retrieval](archival_retrieval/README.md) and [fact verification](claim_only/manuscript.md) supply external retrieval and label tests. Archival locator grounding and evidence-aware superiority on the specified heritage task remain open. |
| P10 | Spiral curriculum planning | [V3 records](../../research_artifacts_v3/release/SCIENTIFIC_READINESS.md) document partial curriculum anchors. [Set cover](set_cover/multifamily/README.md) tests optimization cost. The [Boolean prerequisite study](curriculum_plan/README.md) certified minimum direct repairs on 1,914 three-course bundles and tied the unpruned exact comparator throughout. The [incremental comparison](curriculum_plan/incremental/protocol.md) saved 47.9% of post-edit union attempts with an existing frontier and tied matched recomputation including setup. Teacher correction time remains unmeasured. A public trace with recorded corrections would support a separate observational question. |
| P11 | Reliability of historical-reasoning rubric scores | [Released NLI panel votes](rater_agreement/panel/README.md) support a vote-prediction comparison that ties its matched conditional table. A [three-instructor IELTS panel](rater_agreement/essay_panel/README.md) permits direct analytic-score prediction. Disagreement gating missed the .05 margin. In [third-reader selection](rater_agreement/essay_panel/triage/README.md), ranking by the AI–instructor gap discovered larger discrepancies than supervised ranking. Historical-reasoning ratings remain unmeasured. |
| P12 | Archival claim verification at a page or locator | [Tate revision monitoring](catalog_revisions/manuscript.md) and [lossless updates](catalog_sync/context_events/README.md) quantify changed strings and encoding costs. On [21 PEP heading renames](catalog_revisions/lineage/renames/README.md), the full matcher recovered 19, tying two ablations. Heading identity is a structural proxy. The specified test still needs changed claim-supporting evidence at cited locations. |
| P13 | Early warning with irregular observation schedules | [Day-60 analysis](landmark/manuscript.md) measures risk-set sensitivity. The [federated extension](landmark/federated/README.md) compares seven simulated module clients, FedAvg, FedProx, local, centralized and adaptation controls. Stronger local adaptation wins. The [matched assessment-schedule experiment](landmark/federated/schedule/README.md) gained .00150 AUC against a .02 margin. Replication across independent institutions remains open. |
| P14 | Semantic accessibility of heritage learning objects | [W3C ACT evaluation](accessibility/manuscript.md) compares machine-executable test outcomes. Semantic defect recall on actual learning objects requires released object-level reference labels. |

## Applying the TwinFedSem experimental guide to education

The supplied Phase 1 guide studies IoT intrusion detection. Its methodological contribution relevant here is to cross client data heterogeneity with model heterogeneity, freeze client partitions and assignments across methods, and evaluate both the typical and poorly served clients. P13's current seven modules simulate clients within one university using one model family. This provides a homogeneous-model reference experiment. It cannot establish cross-architecture knowledge transfer, differential privacy or deployment in seven institutions.

For a heterogeneous follow-up, compare local-only fitting and compatible published cross-architecture baselines on identical released educational outcomes. Restrict weight averaging to compatible model families. Compare gated transfer with the same transfer model with its gate removed and with a simple client-local calibration control. Select the gate and its threshold on earlier calibration learners. Record communication, per-client discrimination, calibration and negative transfer relative to local-only training using the same held-out learners. The guide's client counts and IoT class metrics describe its own setting. The number of genuine educational clients and the registered early-warning margin determine the education experiment. Separate development and confirmation, preserve every eligible comparison, and assess simultaneous uncertainty before counting a paper.
